title: Small dwelling subject to the site area concession: maximum internal floor area 70m2
text: Small Dwellings – Site area concession applies – Refer 4.0 Land, C4.1.5, C4.1.6 and C4.1.7. C2.9.1 Small dwellings subject to the site area concession of C4.1.5, C4.1.6 or C4.1.7 shall comply with the following: i. a maximum internal dwelling floor area of 70m2; ii. parking provided in accordance with Table 2.3a; and iii. all other provisions of the R-Codes.

replaces.note: Part B applied at R30 and R40 only; concession now referenced for R25 and below (C4.1.5), R30-R40 (C4.1.6), R50+ (C4.1.7)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Only (i) is encoded. (ii) parking per Table 2.3a is tested by C2.3.1 (Perth and Peel); the cross-reference names Table 2.3a only, so small dwellings outside Perth and Peel have no stated parking requirement (register ch2-034). (iii) all other provisions apply and are tested by their own rules. Register ch2-036: aged/dependent persons' and single bedroom dwellings (Part B 5.5.2, 5.5.3) are deleted; the C4.1.5 small dwelling concession replaces them.
